PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR; FREEMAN ABSENT 
AP
PROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

import re,glob,collections
n=0;cities=collections.Counter();nocity=0;cases=0;noloc=0
for f in glob.glob('*.txt'):
    for p in re.split(r'=== page \d+',open(f).read()):
        if 'Case Number' not in p: continue
        cases+=1
        m=re.search(r'Damage Location:(.*?)\n\s*\n?\s*The IURC',p,re.S)
        if not m: noloc+=1;print(f,'noloc');continue
        loc=' '.join(m.group(1).split())
        if ',' not in loc: nocity+=1;print('nocomma',repr(loc));continue
        c=loc.rsplit(',',1)[1].strip().lower()
        if not c: nocity+=1;continue
        cities[c]+=1
t=sum(cities.values());print(cases,t,nocity,noloc)
top=cities.most_common(8);print(top)
print(sum(v for _,v in top[:5]),sum(v for _,v in top[:5])/t*100)
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/a.py

NUNC PRO TUNC ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
 
 Ind. Code ch . 8-1-26 provides t he procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
 
On February 23, 2022, the Commission upheld the finding of violation by the Pipeline 
Safety Division and approved the recommendation of the Advisory Committee  in Case Number 
24633. Since that time, it has been brought to the Commission ’s attention that the address of the 
damage location  was 7511 Middlefield Road and not 7535 Middlefield . Therefore, the 
Commission fi nds the clerical error made in the  damage location address fo r Case Number 
24633 shall be corrected to read 7511 Middlefield Road as reflected on the attached page.  
 
The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send notice to 
the parties advising them of the determination. 
 
Any approved civil penalties are due with in 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
 
Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
 
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, AND OBER CONCUR; ZIEGNER ABSENT:

and correct copy of the Order as approved.

**Indianapolis** has the most cases, with **1,153**. The five most common cities together account for **26.2%** of the cases that have a city.

- **Top five cities:** Indianapolis (1,153), Fort Wayne (530), Evansville (445), South Bend (295) and Bloomington (184). They total 2,607 cases.
- **Cases with a city:** 9,944. That is the 9,963 recommendation forms across the 58 orders, minus the ones that have no usable city.
- **Percentage:** 2,607 ÷ 9,944 = 26.2%.

Cases with no usable city:
- Nine have no damage location printed at all.
- Three have a location with no comma, such as "3846 Schneider Street" and "7401 ##".
- Several others have an empty city after the comma.

Two forms had a misaligned layout that my first extraction missed. I read their locations by hand: one is Fort Wayne and one is Geneva. Fort Wayne's count includes the Fort Wayne one.
